data_description.port: Port of the freedo HTTP API (http_listen).
data_description.token: Bearer token of the API. Leave it empty when freedo has no token.

hassio_confirm.title: freedo add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant found the freedo add-on. Set up the integration for it?

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description:
Select a room to change it, or Done to close.

| Room | Area | Temperature source | Window sensors |
|---|---|---|---|
{rooms}

room.title: Room {room}
room.description: Submit saves this room and returns to the list of rooms. When you select a Home Assistant sensor as the temperature source and the room has no correction, freedo sets the correction Continuous shift.

data_description.area: The room device moves to the area. Its valves and thermostats move too, unless you placed them in another area. You can also set the area on the device page.
data_description.temperature_source: What measures the room temperature: a device of the room or a Home Assistant sensor. The list shows the devices of the room first, then the sensors of the area that the room has now, then the other sensors with their area. After you change the area, submit and open the room again to see the sensors of the new area first.
data_description.windows: The heating of the room stops while one of these sensors is open. A sensor serves one room: a sensor that another room uses shows that room in square brackets, and it moves to this room.

data_description.correction: Continuous shift moves the setpoints slowly from the reading. It is the recommended method. Valve calibration writes the valve offset at most once per interval, and each write moves the motor once.

data_description.outdoor_entity: Sent to freedo on each change and every 15 minutes. It drives the weather curves of the flow limit.

error.write_failed: freedo refused the change. The Home Assistant log shows the reason.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Load it, then open the options again.

pair.name: Pair a device
pair.description: Sends the pair command to a device that waits in the pair window. freedo must hold the device first: the freedo dashboard adds a device and pairs it on one page. A device can miss the command: send it again while the pair window is open.

device.name: Device
device.description: The EUI of the device, as the attribute joiners of the switch Pairing mode shows it. Leave it empty to pair the one device that waits in the pair window.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: The freedo hub that pairs the device. Needed only when several hubs are loaded.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Starts or stops the boost of a room.

on.name: On
on.description: True starts the boost, false stops it.

set_overlay.name: Set overlay
set_overlay.description: Heats a room to a temperature or switches it off, and sets when the change ends.

hvac_mode.name: Mode
hvac_mode.description: Heat sets the temperature, off switches the room off.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature. Required with mode heat, not allowed with mode off.

end_rule.name: End rule
end_rule.description: Manual lasts until the next command, timer lasts for the duration, until next time block lasts until the next block of the weekly program, until next automatic change lasts until the next block of the weekly program or the next switch between home and away, whichever comes first.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of the timer, up to 7 days. Required with end rule timer, not allowed with the other end rules.

set_window.name: Set open window
set_window.description: Activates or resets the open window state of a room. A reset ends the state, also one the valves detected.

open.name: Open
open.description: True activates the open window state, false resets it.

boost_all.name: Boost all rooms
boost_all.description: Starts or stops the boost of every room.

on.name: On
on.description: True starts the boost, false stops it.

resume_all.name: Resume all schedules
resume_all.description: Returns every room and the hot water to their weekly schedule.

calibrate_gas_meter.name: Calibrate gas meter
calibrate_gas_meter.description: Records a gas meter reading. freedo estimates the meter value between the readings and shows it in the Gas meter sensor.

value.name: Reading
value.description: The meter reading, in the unit of the fuel counter (m3 by default), 0 to 1000000000.

estimate.name: Estimate
estimate.description: The fuel counter when the reading was taken, for a reading taken earlier. Defaults to the current counter.

at.name: Reading time
at.description: The time the reading was taken, not in the future. Defaults to now.

replaced.name: Replaced meter
replaced.description: Set this when the physical meter was replaced: freedo drops the stored readings and starts the new meter from this reading.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: The freedo hub the reading belongs to. Needed only when several hubs are loaded.

undo_gas_meter_reading.name: Undo gas meter reading
undo_gas_meter_reading.description: Removes the last gas meter reading, to undo a typo.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: The freedo hub the reading belongs to. Needed only when several hubs are loaded.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the weekly schedule of a room or the hot water: programs with the days they run on and their time blocks. Without a schedule there are no programs.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the weekly schedule of a room or the hot water. The programs cover each of the seven days once. Each program starts at 00:00 and its times increase.

programs.name: Programs
programs.description: A list of programs. Each has days (mon to sun) and entries. Each entry has time (HH:MM), temperature (5 to 25 °C for a room, 30 to 65 °C for the hot water) and enabled (default true, false switches it off).

copy_schedule.name: Copy schedule
copy_schedule.description: Copies the weekly schedule of a room to other rooms. The hot water does not share a schedule with a room.

to.name: Copy to
to.description: The rooms that get the schedule.

rooms_no_area.title: Rooms without an area
rooms_no_area.description: These freedo rooms work, but they are in no Home Assistant area: {rooms}. Set the area in Settings > Devices & services > freedo > Configure > Rooms, or on the device page of the room. You can ignore this issue.

pair_needs_one_device.message: The pair window holds {count} waiting devices. The field device is needed unless one device waits.

overlay_temperature_required.message: Set a temperature with mode heat.

overlay_temperature_not_allowed.message: A temperature is not allowed with mode off.

overlay_duration_required.message: Set a duration with end rule timer.

overlay_duration_not_allowed.message: A duration needs end rule timer.

not_a_zone.message: {entity_id} is not a freedo room or the freedo hot water.

copy_across_kinds.message: {entity_id} is of another kind. A room and the hot water do not share a schedule: their temperature ranges differ.

copy_to_itself.message: A room cannot copy its schedule to itself.

several_hubs.message: Several freedo hubs are loaded. Name the hub with the config_entry_id field.

unknown_hub.message: No loaded freedo hub has this config_entry_id.

hot_water_temperature_required.message: The hot water has no target temperature. Set one with the temperature control: this also switches it on.

zone_temperature_required.message: The room has no target temperature. Set one with the temperature control. This also selects the mode Heat.
